associationClusters.association: Record national box office and multiple blockbuster records imply a booming cinema market. Compare a single-film producer's lumpy economics with a cinema operator whose monthly ticket revenue and footfall repeatedly convert the same industry demand.

Lower down payments, reserve-ratio easing and rising home prices point to a housing transaction rebound. Search for recurring transaction-linked or furnishing demand only where company conversion is observable by Q1; do not infer generic property upside.

A record one-day iron-ore surge signaled a violent expectations reset around China stimulus. Separate actual steel/raw-material profit transfer from commodity narrative and reject if pricing moves far ahead of company earnings.

Low oil materially reduced airline fuel costs while yuan weakness generated large FX losses. Treat the combined net effect as a company cash/earnings bridge only if contemporaneous reports show recurring operating improvement rather than a one-factor story.

A record parent-level acquisition may create strategic integration optionality for Chinese chemical/agri assets, but listed subsidiaries require a direct and contemporaneous earnings/asset-injection bridge; parent-level narrative alone is insufficient.

Baidu's autonomous-driving push can create sensor, mapping and vehicle-electronics demand, but Q1 2016 evidence must show real customer/order conversion at a listed company; concept exposure alone is rejected.
Yuan depreciation, reserve loss and market stress change FX-sensitive company economics and financing conditions. Search for direct balance-sheet sensitivity; avoid broad financial-beta selections.
